g.desc: TI SCES351Y and SCES296AG (buffers), Diodes DS41326 (AP63205) and DS39724 (AP2112),

g.text: ECS ECX-33Q (crystal, CL 12 pF -> 18 pF). Low fuse 0xFF (low-power crystal oscillator).

g.desc: ECS ECX-33Q (crystal, CL 12 pF -> 18 pF). Low fuse 0xFF (low-power crystal oscillator).

g.text: JP1 (bridged as delivered) joins the DTR# auto-reset to RESET: cut it for debugWIRE.

g.desc: JP1 (bridged as delivered) joins the DTR# auto-reset to RESET: cut it for debugWIRE.

g.text: Power: USB-C 5 V through F1, or 7-12 V on J2 through D1 and the AP63205.

g.desc: Power: USB-C 5 V through F1, or 7-12 V on J2 through D1 and the AP63205.

g.text: U3 picks the jack's 5 V whenever it is present and blocks reverse current,

g.desc: U3 picks the jack's 5 V whenever it is present and blocks reverse current,

g.text: so neither input, nor 5 V fed into the 5V pin, back-feeds the other.

g.desc: so neither input, nor 5 V fed into the 5V pin, back-feeds the other.
